==Notes==
* When you activate this skill, all [[Upkeep]] Enchantments you maintain will be removed.
* For the first 30 seconds, it's impossible to use [[Totem of Man]] as it is recharging.
* When the blessing ends, you get your original skill bar back and Ursan Blessing starts recharging.
* Since this blessing and all associated skills do not require a weapon to be used, they can be used while carrying [[bundle]]s.
* Several effects do not end upon activating this skill: 
** [[Air of Superiority]] is not lost upon using this skill. Since it has a 10% chance on killing an enemy to instantly recharge [[Totem of Man]], it may allow you to transform back into Human form before the 30 seconds.
** [[Troll Unguent]] and [[Protector's Defense]] are also kept when this skill is activated.
** Even though [[Signet of Stamina]] does not end upon activation, you will not gain any additional Maximum Health.
** [[Together as One]] and [[Never Rampage Alone]] are also kept.
{{research needed|Which effects do the Norn elite forms remove and which ones do they leave?}}
*Synergizes well with [[Binding Ritual]]s; the spirits will keep attacking even when your normal skills are disabled, and the spirits' attacks are affected by Ursan Roar. 

{{anomaly|Although it is classified as a Form, the caster does not change appearance.}}
{{bug|If you obtain a new skill (as a [[quest reward]]) you may equip it in any of the free slots and use it. After turning back to human form, you keep the skill but cannot use it until you swap it with another skill.}}

==Trivia==
*Since the [[Bear Spirit]] is female, the name of this skill is likely taken from the the Latin "ursa", meaning "female bear".
*After release of Guild Wars: Eye of the North, this skill was very powerful and was widely used by players to conquer high-end PvE content with relatively ease for quite a while. But after it became too dominant the skill was nerfed and lost its role in the metagame.
